layout.notebook_first:
Everything you add, the singularity will erase. Only this remains.
Carry the rubber duck. It breaks the first loop.

notes.text: You won't find the ration tin unless you carry the rubber duck. Don't ask me how I know.

Looked everywhere for the duct tape. It was never there until I picked up the ration tin.
You won't find the circuit board unless you carry the ration tin and the duct tape. Don't ask me how I know.
The voice recorder with the flashlight, and nothing else that matters. That door hurts.
The circuit board only shows up for someone carrying the ration tin and the duct tape.
Engines. The ration tin, the duct tape, the circuit board. Nothing else but this notebook. Drop the rubber duck when the time comes.
Carried the pressure gauge through a dozen doors. Nothing changed. Drop it.
The engine room answers to three things: the ration tin, the duct tape and the circuit board. Keep the notebook. The rubber duck has done its job. Let it go.
Remember how you got to the bridge.
The data cartridge is junk. The doors don't care about it.
